page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Marginal notes in the right margin. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. A small "74" at the bottom right is uncertain (see notes).

main_text.p: ter; vel abutimur, vel non agnoscimus. Illicitis seuerè interdicit, ruptis legum & modestiae repa-Psal.gulis, cum gentibus vociferamur in Psalmo Difrumpamus vincula eorum & proiciamus a nobis tales funes, promoti sumus vltra meti-tum. Vel [illegible, ~4 letters] influti surgescimus, aut so-cordiâ torpidi in Epicuros & Ardeliones obru-tescimus. Sic ut alijs adfricamus contagiosam tentiginem, vel [illegible, ~9 letters] vel exemplo, aut vitia vlterius nostra ferre possumus, aut remedia.

Quomodo facta est haec Academia apud Exteros huc vsq; adeo celebris, apud Domesticos subitò vilis, & quasi mensae fabula. Expectârunt Boni post nuperum, nec satis adhuc obdùctum contagionis vulnus, vel cum Æaco apud Ovidium, ex Formicis laboriosos Mermidonas, vel cum Aristaeo apud Virgilium (praesertim in hoc Boum Vado) ex Iuvencorum cadaveribus Apes sedulas, sed Fuci prodiere & Crabrones ad bombilandum tantùm, aut pungendum, non ad mellificandum comparati.Metamorp. l. 7.Georg. 4. Cognovit Bos possessorem suum, & Asinus praesepe Domini fui; sed nos saltâ sumus, sicut Equus & Mulus, quibus non est intellectus, quos nulli Cani aut Frena constringant, aut retrahant à praecipitijs.

page.notes: Marginal reference marks in the right margin: "Psal." beside line 2 (number unclear), "Metamorp. l. 7." (the scan reads "l.7" or "l.9", uncertain), "Georg. 4." beside Virgilium, and "Psal. 32." beside Equus (the number is uncertain, so I read it as "32."). A marginal "Cog. 1." beside "novit" is uncertain; I have not included it as a separate note, because the scan is too faint to read reliably. Faint marks in the right margin (possibly "1,7" or a mark in the middle of the margin) look like stains or show-through and are left out. Words in the second line of the first paragraph ("metitum", "obdùctum", "saltâ") are read from a low-resolution scan and may be wrong. The phrase "Vel [illegible] influti" and the phrase "vel [illegible] vel exemplo" are damaged. The "74" at the bottom right is not transcribed; it may be a page reference or a catchword-like mark and is not clearly part of the text.
